name: Sepulchrine-Spandrel
description: The crust never rests here. Rivers of incandescent basalt vein the lowlands, ash climbs from vents along every fault, and beyond active supervolcanoes the sky stays the color of a bruise.

The air carries dust and something faintly floral, and sound behaves strangely: footsteps crack loud, then die without echo. At night the temperature drops fast enough to hear the rock tick as it contracts.
The descent was survivable; what came after was not. Salvage rights to starship crash site (colony ship) are contested by three claimants, two of them dead.
Opportunity here wears armor. Claims on exotic matter and geothermal energy are staked, defended, and occasionally avenged, and the nearest law is a week's burn away.
